case.query: On a CV-X482, what should a technician check for Error 13101, and on an IV4-G120, what should they check when image data cannot be transferred to the SD card?
case.expected_snippet: For CV-X482 Error 13101, make sure flow control is not set to CTS/RTS in the RS-232C settings and check the serial cable. For IV4-G120 image-data transfer failure, check that the settings are correct and the SD card is correctly inserted.

Error Number: 13101; Error Messages: An RS-232C communication time out error has occurred.; Cause: RS-232C communication has been down for 60 or more seconds when data output via the RS-232C is specified in the output settings.; Remedy: • Make sure flow control is not set to [CTS/RTS] in the RS-232C settings. • Make sure the serial cable is not disconnected.

Error Number: 13001; Error Messages: Failed in the communication with the PC Program.; Cause: An error occurred with the Ethernet communication when the data is output to a PC program.; Remedy: • Make sure the Ethernet cable is connected to the controller and the PC/PLC. • Make sure the LAN cable is not disconnected. • Check the Ethernet cable type (cross, straight). • Check whether the PC at the other end of the connection is ready to transmit/receive data. • Check that the correct PC program is running on the PC and that the PC is connected to the controller.
Error Number: 13002; Error Messages: Unable to output to PC Program due to a full output buffer.; Cause: The controller output buffer for outputting to PC Programs is full.; Remedy: Reduce the amount of data to be output, so that the data for each measurement is output at a slower rate than they are output to the PC Program. Or, extend the time between triggers/processing to allow for data to be output. Note: Results data are not written when the buffer is full.
